narrative: Weekend escalation in the Strait of Hormuz dominates headlines as Iran rejects shipping protocols, setting up a crude-led bid for CAD and AUD at the Tokyo open. While weak NFP data shifted Fed expectations, the geopolitical risk premium and a +135bp OIS carry advantage likely support USD/CAD from Friday's 1.3938 close. USD/JPY closed Friday at 157.75; despite a -2.20 risk reversal skew, safe-haven USD demand may counter JPY strength as the RBA rate decision on Tuesday anchors the high-beta AUD/USD (Friday close: 0.7071) as the primary carry vehicle.
